name: Agrate Brianza (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Agrate Brianza (a red dragon on white, crowned, within olive and oak branches).
history: Municipal flag of Agrate Brianza, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Agrate Brianza arms — a red dragon on white, crowned, within olive and oak branches
